macros.name: leveldown
macros.doc: This command goes down one level in the document hierarchy, so depending on where you are, this will insert an outline element <title> at one level below the current.

macros.name: levelmultiup
macros.doc: This goes up multiple levels in the document hierarchy, so depending on where you are, this will insert an outline element <title> at a level differing by <levels> from the current level.

macros.name: levelstay
macros.doc: This command stays at the current document hierarchy level, so depending on where you are, this will insert an outline element <title> at the same as the current level.

macros.name: levelup
macros.doc: This command goes up one level in the document hierarchy, so depending on where you are, this will insert an outline element <title> at one level above the current.
